aqi.sensitive: Mara kyau ga Ƙungiyoyi Masu Hankali
advice.good: Ingancin iska yana da kyau. Jin daɗin ayyukan waje!
advice.moderate: Inganci matsakaici. Mutane masu hankali su iyakance fallasa mai tsawo.

insight.good: Iska tana da tsabta saboda iska mai kyau. Lafiya ga dukkan ayyuka.
insight.moderate: Tarin barbashi kaɗan. Yanayin yana da kyau ga yawancin mutane.

insight.unhealthy: An lura da yawan barbashi. Yana nuna hanyoyin konewa na gida.
insight.hazardous: Ingancin iska yana da haɗari. Zauna a gida kuma tace iska idan zai yiwu.
about.title: Game da Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI tana ƙididdige yawan PM2.5 kullum a ƙasashe 54 na Afirka.
about.overview.problem_desc: Yawancin biranen Afirka ba su da na'urorin lura da ingancin iska. Muna cika wannan gibi.
about.how.intro: Amfani da bayanan tauraron dan adam da koyon na'ura.
about.how.step1.title: Tauraron Dan Adam a matsayin Na'urori
about.how.step1.desc: Amfani da bayanan ESA Sentinel-5P da NASA MERRA-2.
about.how.step2.title: Daidaitawar Ƙasa
about.how.step2.desc: An horar da samfuri a tashoshin lura 398 a ƙasashe 29.
about.how.step3.title: Binciken Nahiya
about.how.step3.desc: Samfurin XGBoost yana hasashen PM2.5 don kowane wurin Afirka.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Tauraron dan adam ba zai iya gani ta cikin gajimare kauri ba.
about.limit.gap_desc: Wucewar tauraron dan adam kullum na iya ɓata ƙananan hauhawar gurɓatawa.
about.limit.legal_desc: Kimantawa ba ma'aunai tabbatattun ba ne.
about.who.citizens_desc: Duba ingancin iska kafin ayyukan waje.
